angularDiameterSource: No angular diameter is measured: this is the record's radius at the Gaia distance.

radiusSource: Temperature 4573 +/- 10 K, mass 1.00 +/- 0.02 solar masses and radius 1.01 +/- 0.02 solar radii as the ESO SupJup survey tabulates them (Zhang et al. 2024, arXiv:2409.16660, Table 1), from Bohn et al.
